005package org.wpilib.telemetry;
006
007import java.util.Collection;
008import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.Protobuf;
009import org.wpilib.util.struct.Struct;
010
011/**
012 * Telemetry sends information from the robot program to dashboards, debug tools, or log files.
013 *
014 * <p>For more advanced use cases, use the NetworkTables or DataLog APIs directly.
015 */
016public final class Telemetry {
017  /** The root {@link TelemetryTable}. */
018  private static final TelemetryTable m_root = TelemetryRegistry.getTable("/");
019
020  private Telemetry() {
021    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * Gets the root telemetry table.
026   *
027   * @return table
028   */
029  public static TelemetryTable getTable() {
030    return m_root;
031  }
032
033  /**
034   * Gets a child telemetry table.
035   *
036   * @param name table name
037   * @return table
038   */
039  public static TelemetryTable getTable(String name) {
040    return m_root.getTable(name);
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Indicates duplicate values should be preserved. Normally duplicate values are ignored.
045   *
046   * @param name the name
047   */
048  public static void keepDuplicates(String name) {
049    m_root.keepDuplicates(name);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Sets property for a value. Properties are stored as a key/value map.
054   *
055   * @param name the name
056   * @param key property key
057   * @param value property value
058   */
059  public static void setProperty(String name, String key, String value) {
060    m_root.setProperty(name, key, value);
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Logs a generic object.
065   *
066   * <p>For non-null values, the value is dispatched in this order: {@link TelemetryLoggable},
067   * {@link org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable}, {@link
068   * org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable}, boxed primitive and string types, and finally
069   * handlers registered with {@link TelemetryRegistry#registerTypeHandler(Class,
070   * TelemetryRegistry.TypeHandler)}. {@link TelemetryLoggable} values are logged to a child table
071   * named {@code name}. Struct and protobuf serializable values are logged with their public static
072   * {@code struct} or {@code proto} serializers. {@link Boolean}, {@link Float}, {@link Double},
073   * {@link Byte}, {@link Short}, {@link Integer}, {@link Long}, other {@link Number} values, and
074   * {@link String} are logged as primitive or string entries. Generic {@link Number} values other
075   * than boxed integral types are logged as double entries. If no registered handler matches, the
076   * value falls back to being logged as a string using {@link Object#toString()}. Collection values
077   * must be logged with an explicit element type.
078   *
079   * @param name the name
080   * @param value the value; must be non-null
081   */
082  public static void log(String name, Object value) {
083    m_root.log(name, value);
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Logs an object with a Struct serializer.
088   *
089   * @param <T> data type
090   * @param name the name
091   * @param value the value
092   * @param struct struct serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
093   */
094  public static <T> void log(String name, T value, Struct<? super T> struct) {
095    m_root.log(name, value, struct);
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Logs an object with a Protobuf serializer.
100   *
101   * @param <T> data type
102   * @param name the name
103   * @param value the value
104   * @param proto protobuf serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
105   */
106  public static <T> void log(String name, T value, Protobuf<? super T, ?> proto) {
107    m_root.log(name, value, proto);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Logs a generic array.
112   *
113   * <p>{@link Byte} arrays are logged as raw byte arrays.
114   *
115   * @param name the name
116   * @param value the value
117   */
118  public static void log(String name, Object[] value) {
119    m_root.log(name, value);
120  }
121
122  /**
123   * Logs an array of objects with a Struct serializer.
124   *
125   * @param <T> data type
126   * @param name the name
127   * @param value the value
128   * @param struct struct serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
129   */
130  public static <T> void log(String name, T[] value, Struct<? super T> struct) {
131    m_root.log(name, value, struct);
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Rejects logging a collection without an explicit element type.
136   *
137   * <p>Use {@link #log(String, Collection, Class)} or {@link #log(String, Collection, Struct)}
138   * instead.
139   *
140   * @param name the name
141   * @param value the value
142   * @throws CollectionElementTypeRequiredException always
143   */
144  public static void log(String name, Collection<?> value)
145      throws CollectionElementTypeRequiredException {
146    throw new CollectionElementTypeRequiredException();
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Logs a collection of objects with a Struct serializer.
151   *
152   * @param <T> data type
153   * @param name the name
154   * @param value the value
155   * @param struct struct serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
156   */
157  public static <T> void log(String name, Collection<T> value, Struct<? super T> struct) {
158    m_root.log(name, value, struct);
159  }
160
161  /**
162   * Logs a collection with an explicit element type.
163   *
164   * <p>The element type selects the backend representation. {@link Byte} element types are logged
165   * as raw byte arrays. {@link Boolean}, {@link Float}, {@link Double}, and {@link String} element
166   * types are logged like arrays of the same element type. {@link Number} and other non-integral
167   * number element types are logged as double arrays. {@link Short}, {@link Integer}, and {@link
168   * Long} element types are logged as integer arrays. Struct-serializable element types are logged
169   * with their public static {@code struct} serializer. Other element types fall back to string
170   * arrays using {@link Object#toString()}.
171   *
172   * @param name the name
173   * @param value the value
174   * @param elementType the collection element type
175   */
176  public static void log(String name, Collection<?> value, Class<?> elementType) {
177    m_root.log(name, value, elementType);
178  }
179
180  /**
181   * Logs a boolean.
182   *
183   * @param name the name
184   * @param value the value
185   */
186  public static void log(String name, boolean value) {
187    m_root.log(name, value);
188  }
189
190  /**
191   * Logs a byte.
192   *
193   * @param name the name
194   * @param value the value
195   */
196  public static void log(String name, byte value) {
197    m_root.log(name, value);
198  }
199
200  /**
201   * Logs a short.
202   *
203   * @param name the name
204   * @param value the value
205   */
206  public static void log(String name, short value) {
207    m_root.log(name, value);
208  }
209
210  /**
211   * Logs an int.
212   *
213   * @param name the name
214   * @param value the value
215   */
216  public static void log(String name, int value) {
217    m_root.log(name, value);
218  }
219
220  /**
221   * Logs a long.
222   *
223   * @param name the name
224   * @param value the value
225   */
226  public static void log(String name, long value) {
227    m_root.log(name, value);
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Logs a float.
232   *
233   * @param name the name
234   * @param value the value
235   */
236  public static void log(String name, float value) {
237    m_root.log(name, value);
238  }
239
240  /**
241   * Logs a double.
242   *
243   * @param name the name
244   * @param value the value
245   */
246  public static void log(String name, double value) {
247    m_root.log(name, value);
248  }
249
250  /**
251   * Logs a String.
252   *
253   * @param name the name
254   * @param value the value
255   */
256  public static void log(String name, String value) {
257    m_root.log(name, value);
258  }
259
260  /**
261   * Logs a String with custom type string.
262   *
263   * @param name the name
264   * @param value the value
265   * @param typeString the type string
266   */
267  public static void log(String name, String value, String typeString) {

272   * Logs a boolean array.
273   *
274   * @param name the name
275   * @param value the value
276   */
277  public static void log(String name, boolean[] value) {
278    m_root.log(name, value);

282   * Logs a short array.

284   * @param name the name

287  public static void log(String name, short[] value) {
288    m_root.log(name, value);

292   * Logs an int array.

294   * @param name the name

296   */
297  public static void log(String name, int[] value) {

302   * Logs a long array.

304   * @param name the name

306   */
307  public static void log(String name, long[] value) {

312   * Logs a float array.

314   * @param name the name

317  public static void log(String name, float[] value) {

327  public static void log(String name, double[] value) {

361}
